Hi Kim — thanks for the quick reply. Answers inline below: 

1) Use case: primarily customer-facing chat (account support + billing assistant) with a secondary batch job for triage embeddings.
2) Traffic: baseline is around 200–300 concurrent users across the site (expected to convert to ~40–80 RPS during business hours). We expect bursts up to ~400 RPS during monthly billing runs. Monthly token consumption estimate is 5M–7M after we tune prompts.
3) Data sensitivity: hosted is fine for the pilot but we will need VPC + KMS for production (SOC2 requirement).
4) Timeline: Q1 pilot start is preferred; decision gating on security questionnaire and a short PoC within 6–8 weeks.

Proposed times (PT): Wed 1 Dec 13:00 works for me — can you confirm? Also attaching a quick spreadsheet with our rough priority matrix and estimates.
